subject: Consolidate technical walkthrough + procurement sync — timing conflict
messages:
From: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@catalyze.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwoodai.com
Cc: Procurement <procurement@catalyze.ai>, Sofia Moreno <sofia.moreno@catalyze.ai>
Date: 2027-05-28T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request to consolidate technical walkthrough + procurement sync

Hi Soojin,

We're trying to compress our onboarding calendar so we can finish vendor selection before our quarter close. Instead of two back-to-back sessions (tech walkthrough + procurement questions), would Redwood be able to run a single consolidated session where an SE covers architecture + an AE handles pricing/contract questions, and we bring procurement on for the final 20-30 minutes?

Current constraints: our lead engineer (Sofia) will be in transit the week of June 7–11, and procurement only has windows after 3pm PT that same week. We prefer a single 90-minute slot the week of June 14 if possible.

If you can share an agenda and any pre-read (SOC2 snapshot, expected SLOs, pricing examples), that would help speed approval.

Thanks — Rajiv
Senior Product Ops, Catalyze.ai

Attachment: SOC2-summary.pdf (pdf)
From: aditya_rao@redwoodai.com
To: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@catalyze.ai>, soojin_lee@redwoodai.com
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwoodai.com, mina_haddad@redwoodai.com
Date: 2027-05-28T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to consolidate technical walkthrough + procurement sync

Hi Rajiv — appreciate the context and timeline. We can definitely aim to consolidate. Proposed approach: 60 minutes technical walkthrough (diego) + 30 minutes procurement-specific Q&A (me + Soojin). Before the call, we'll send a one-page agenda and the SOC2 snapshot.

Quick note: Diego will be on travel for a customer onsite from June 9–13 (returning late on the 13th). That makes the week of June 7 tricky for technical coverage; June 14–18 looks workable on our side.

Proposed tentative slots (all PT):
- Tue Jun 15 10:00–11:30
- Wed Jun 16 13:30–15:00
- Thu Jun 17 15:30–17:00 (if your procurement prefers after 3pm)

Sofia (I copied your procurement address) — confirm which of those works for you and whether you want the procurement segment earlier or at the end.

I'll attach an agenda draft.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: consolidated-agenda-v1.docx (docx)
From: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@catalyze.ai>
To: aditya_rao@redwoodai.com, soojin_lee@redwoodai.com
Cc: Procurement <procurement@catalyze.ai>, Sofia Moreno <sofia.moreno@catalyze.ai>
Date: 2027-05-29T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to consolidate technical walkthrough + procurement sync

Thanks Aditya — Thu Jun 17 15:30–17:00 PT would be ideal since procurement needs after-3pm. One potential blocker: our security lead (Sofia) flagged that she needs a short session with your security engineer ahead of the walkthrough to review data retention and audit log behavior. She suggested a 30-minute pre-call the morning of Thu Jun 17.

If that's a problem because Diego is traveling earlier in the week, can we either: 1) have your security engineer join remotely for the pre-call and main session, or 2) push the consolidated session to the following week (June 21–25)? Procurement approval is a gating item for the deal.

Regards,
Rajiv
From: diego_fernandez@redwoodai.com
To: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@catalyze.ai>, aditya_rao@redwoodai.com, soojin_lee@redwoodai.com
Cc: mina_haddad@redwoodai.com
Date: 2027-05-29T12:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to consolidate technical walkthrough + procurement sync

On Thu, May 29, 2027 at 09:18 AM Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@catalyze.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Aditya — Thu Jun 17 15:30–17:00 PT would be ideal since procurement needs after-3pm. One potential blocker: our security lead (Sofia) flagged that she needs a short session with your security engineer ahead of the walkthrough to review data retention and audit log behavior.

Hi all — thanks for flagging. I can join both the pre-call and the main session remotely. Small heads-up: I'm scheduled for an internal onboarding the morning of Jun 17 (hard stop at 12:30 PT) but free in the afternoon. Mina from our security team can cover the pre-call if there are any overlap risks; Mina, are you OK to take a 30-minute pre-call at 10:00 AM PT on Thu Jun 17?

If Mina can't, I recommend we move the consolidated session to the week of Jun 21 so Sofia has flexibility and procurement still gets a live presence. I don't want to risk rushed answers to security questions.

Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: mina_haddad@redwoodai.com
To: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@catalyze.ai>, aditya_rao@redwoodai.com, diego_fernandez@redwoodai.com, soojin_lee@redwoodai.com
Date: 2027-05-31T11:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to consolidate technical walkthrough + procurement sync

Hi Rajiv — Mina here from Redwood security. I can cover the 30-minute pre-call on Thu Jun 17 at 10:00 AM PT to walk through data retention, audit logs, and encryption-in-transit details. I'll bring our SOC2 summary and a short diagram of how retention pointers map to customer buckets.

Given Diego's travel and your procurement constraints, here's my recommended plan:
- Thu Jun 17 10:00–10:30 PT: security pre-call (Mina + Sofia)
- Thu Jun 17 15:30–17:00 PT: consolidated walkthrough (Diego + Aditya + Soojin) with procurement joining at 15:45 for the Q&A portion

If procurement needs additional contractual language, we can follow up with the legal team and provide a tailored clause. Otherwise, let's lock Thu Jun 17 and I'll add the security pre-call to the invite.

Sent from my mobile — will follow up with a calendar invite and the SOC2 snapshot link.

Mina Haddad
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
